## Terms of Service

*Last updated: October 31, 2026*

These Terms of Service ("Terms") govern your use of MediaLit, a media storage and delivery API with an MCP server, available at medialit.cloud, including the website, dashboard, API, CLI and MCP server (together, the "Service"). The Service is operated by CodeLitDev Private Limited, a company incorporated in India and registered in Indore, Madhya Pradesh ("CodeLit", "we", "us" or "our"). By creating an account or using the Service, you agree to these Terms. If you use the Service on behalf of an organisation, you agree to them on its behalf and confirm you have the authority to do so.

## 1. Your account

You need an account to use most of the Service. You must give us a valid email address, keep access to it, and keep your API keys and access tokens secret. You are responsible for everything done through your account, your apps, your API keys and any AI agent or CLI you connect. Tell us at [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev) straight away if you think someone has accessed your account without permission. You must be at least 16 years old to use the Service.

- interfere with or overload the Service, or use it in a way that harms other users;

We may remove content, suspend links, or restrict accounts that we reasonably believe break these rules, and we may report illegal content to the authorities.

You are responsible for Your Content and for having the rights to upload it. Files you mark as public can be opened by anyone with the link. We do not use Your Content to train AI models. How we handle personal data is described in our Privacy Policy at [medialit.cloud/privacy](https://medialit.cloud/privacy).

## 5. Plans and billing

MediaLit offers a free Basic plan and a paid Pro plan. Plan features and limits are shown on our pricing page and may change from time to time.

- Payments for paid plans are processed by Lemon Squeezy, which acts as our payment provider. We do not see or store your full card details. Your payment is also subject to Lemon Squeezy's own terms.

- Paid plans are billed in advance for each billing period and renew automatically until you cancel.

- Prices exclude any applicable taxes unless stated otherwise. Taxes may be added at checkout.

- If a payment fails, we may move your account to the Basic plan or restrict uploads until payment succeeds.

- If we change the price of a paid plan, we will tell you in advance, and the new price applies from your next billing period.

## 6. Cancellation and refunds

You can cancel a paid plan at any time. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period and then moves to the Basic plan. Unless the law requires otherwise, fees already paid are not refundable. If your files exceed the Basic plan's limits after a downgrade, we may limit new uploads, and we may ask you to reduce your storage within a reasonable time.

## 7. Open source and self-hosting

MediaLit is open-source software, and its code is published at [github.com/codelitdev/medialit](https://github.com/codelitdev/medialit). If you host MediaLit yourself, you run it under its open-source licence, not these Terms, and we do not provide that installation as a service. These Terms apply only to the hosted Service at medialit.cloud.

You can connect AI assistants and other tools to the Service through our MCP server, CLI or API. Those tools act on your behalf with the permissions you approve. Their providers' own terms and policies apply to them, and we are not responsible for what they do with files or data they access.
